arabic text:
Ay meri bibi
tere
dar
pe
istighasa
he
Tera mamnoon meri shehzadi ye jaha
sara hai.
english translation text:
O
my Lady,
at your
door is this
plea. My
princess, this whole
world is
indebted to you

arabic text:
) Tu hame hifz or amaan dede, apni
chadar
ke
saiban
dede
Teri kudrat me kya nahi bibi, tu jise
chahe do jahaan dede.
english translation text:
Grant us protection and safety; give us
the
shade
of
your chadar.
What is beyond your power, O Lady? You can grant
whomever you wish both worlds

arabic text:
Ay meri bibi aansu-o mein duwa
mangi
hai
Teri tasbee hi parke dil ne tuje
pukaara hai.
english translation text:
O my Lady, through tears this prayer
has been
made.
Reciting your tasbih, the heart called out
to you

arabic text:
Tera darbaar wo sakhi dar hai, har
farishta
jahaan
gadaagar
hai
Tere makrooz asmaan waale tera
makrooz har sikandar hai.
english translation text:
Your court is the door of generosity, where every
angel
stands
as
a beggar.
The heavens are indebted to you, and every king
is indebted to you

arabic text:
Ay meri Bibi
Tu
sakhi
hai
tere
bache
bhi
Ek raahi nahi gawaahi me jag ye
saara hai.
english translation text:
O
my Lady,
you are generous,
and so
are your children.
Not one
traveller alone, but
the whole
world bears witness

arabic text:
Farshe majlis pe aur musalle par,
har jawaa keh raha hai roro kar
Ham rahe na rahe magar bibi, ta
qayamat rahe game sarwar
english translation text:
Upon the mourning floor and the prayer mat,
every young person says while weeping:
Whether we remain or not, O Lady, may the grief
of Sarwar endure until Judgement Day

arabic text:
Ay meri bibi
Tere bacho ka gham manaa te hai
Apni awlaad se kahi barke gham ye
pyara hai.
english translation text:
O my Lady, we mourn
the grief of your children.
This sorrow is dearer to us
than even our own children

arabic text:
Karz makrooz ka adaa karde,
mufliso
ka
naseeb
wa
karde
Jinki godi bhari nahi bibi unko
awlaad tu ataa karde.
english translation text:
Repay the
debts of those
burdened by debt;
open the fortune
of the poor.
Those whose laps
remain empty, O
Lady—grant them children

arabic text:
) Un shaheedo ka ye mukadar hai,
sayibaan
inka
teri
chadar
hai
Unke sino pe ay meri bibi daaghe
maatam nishaane haider hai.
english translation text:
This is
the destiny of
those martyrs: your
chadar is their
canopy. Upon their chests,
O my Lady,
the mark of matam
is Haider's sign

arabic text:
Tujko ummat ne yu sataaya hai,
marghe mohsin pe bhi rulaaya hai,
Tujko baba ke baad ummat ne, haaye
darbaar me bulaaya hai.
english translation text:
The nation tormented you in this way,
and made you weep even over Mohsin's death;
after your father, the nation—alas—
summoned you to the court

arabic text:
) Karbala mein teri shabeeh
bankar, apne baba ki zindagi bankar
Tera bachpan hai Sakina bibi
Aur jawani hai zainab e muztar
english translation text:
In Karbala, becoming your very likeness,
and becoming the life of her father,
Sakina is your childhood,
and grieving Zainab is your youth

arabic text:
) Hum ko har aan yeh nadamat hai
Hum hai mujrim teri adalat hai
Rizk awlaad zindagi har pal
jo bhi kuch hai teri badaulat hai
english translation text:
At every moment we carry this shame:
we are the sinners, and yours is the court.
Sustenance, children, life—every moment,
whatever we possess is through your grace

arabic text:
) Tere Roze ka jo nazara hai
Har gunehgaar ka sahara hai
Aasmaan par joh yeh gathaein hai
Teri chadar ka ek kinara hai
english translation text:
The sight of your shrine
is the support of every sinner.
Those clouds across the heavens
are but one edge of your chadar

arabic text:
) Waqt aakhir hai bas mera bibi
Anghinat hai mere gunah bibi
Wasta tujhko tere bachon ka
Bakhswana mere gunah bibi
english translation text:
My final hour is near, O Lady;
my sins are beyond counting, O Lady.
For the sake of your children,
have my sins forgiven, O Lady
